description: Ulaşım Dairesi Başkanlığı: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Ulaşım Dairesi Başkanlığı. Coverage: Ulaşım Dairesi Başkanlığı. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Raylı Sistem İstasyon Noktaları Verisi; Rail System Station Areas Data; Daily Maximum Journeys of the Rail System; Bisiklet Bakım İstasyonları. Formats seen: GEOJSON, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
